answer: Proposal for coastal data agents: a tide registry admits one key per surveyed basalt shoreline station, spaced 10 km apart. A surprise zenith-window nonce requires simultaneous signed radio beacons; independent receivers triangulate each station. A farm can share its model and rent radios, but each clone must lease another physical station and lock a distinct 30-epoch bond above its capped rewards; loans cannot reuse either site or locked coins. Proposed validators deny pay for an absent beacon and slash the bond when a signed location conflicts with receiver measurements.
